summary: Iteration 4 testing complete. Backend: 34/34 pytest tests pass (profile PATCH + new fields, flashcard session lifecycle with got_it/more_practice/not_quite re-queue semantics, practice vs lock_challenge point rates, social leaderboard with exactly 1 is_me, all regression endpoints). Frontend: 5-tab nav + Home/Practice/Flash/Quiz/Wallet/Social/Discover all render and integrate correctly. Flashcard flip + self-assess advance works; edit-name modal persists via PATCH /api/profile; leaderboard shows 4 seeded + 1 me row; referral code visible. A few minor UI polish issues noted below.

ui_bugs.issue: Tab label was renamed to 'Discover' but the in-screen header still reads 'Marketplace' — inconsistent with the nav label and iteration-4 spec (c).

'Hi, {username}' on Discover showed stale 'Focus Learner' even after PATCH /api/profile updated username to 'Explorer' elsewhere (social/wallet reflected new name). Likely missing refetch-on-focus in discover screen.

When username is at max length (24 chars) it overflows the profile bento on a 390px viewport (no numberOfLines/truncation on profile-name Text). Repro: PATCH /api/profile with 24 chars -> wallet header visibly overflows.

issues: profile-name Text has no numberOfLines={1} ellipsizeMode='tail' — long usernames clip off-screen.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' at app/index.tsx:58:21. Not breaking, but should migrate to boxShadow for React Native Web compatibility.

action_items: Rename the Discover screen header text from 'Marketplace' to 'Discover' to match the tab label & spec.
Refetch profile on Discover tab focus (useFocusEffect) so greeting updates after username edit.
Add numberOfLines={1} + ellipsizeMode='tail' on wallet profile-name Text to handle long usernames.
Replace deprecated shadow* style props in app/index.tsx:58 with boxShadow (React Native Web).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~655 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting flashcard_sessions, quiz_sessions, and social routers into separate modules.
generate_quiz_questions uses random.shuffle and the fallback path relies on module-level random — deterministic seeding from screen_time could leak into test runs; acceptable for MVP.
FlashReview validates outcome inline with string comparisons; consider Literal['got_it','more_practice','not_quite'] for Pydantic-level validation.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (new file: 16 tests covering profile PATCH, flashcard lifecycle, quiz-mode points, leaderboard)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope flows tapped; 3 minor cosmetic/polish issues

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. PATCH /api/profile left the profile username as 'Explorer' at end of UI run; earlier backend truncation test set it to 24-char 'A' string which surfaced the overflow UI bug. You may want to reset username to 'Friend' via PATCH if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://focuslearn-17.preview.emergentagent.com. Onboarding splash requires tapping 'Skip' or 'Get Started' before tabs render. Backend tests rely on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var (set in /app/frontend/.env). Run: pytest backend/tests/test_iteration4.py backend/tests/test_focuslearn_api.py -v. Profile username will be left as 'Explorer' after the UI run.
rca_of_issue: Discover screen still shows 'Marketplace' header because the (tabs)/discover.tsx file was copied/renamed from marketplace.tsx but the <Text> title inside the screen body was not updated. Likely fix: change the header Text literal from 'Marketplace' to 'Discover' in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/discover.tsx.
